in_latin.name: Pascoal
in_latin.meaning: Paschalis, a surname derived from the Hebrew word 'pesach' meaning 'passover'
in_latin.long_meaning: Paschalis est a surname quod derivatum est a Hebraeo verbo 'pesach' quod significat 'passio Domini' seu 'passio Christi'.
